High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Lando Calrissian (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Cloud City, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/Lando Calrissian _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/17bQ1X0Va9vENxxUX5hcaW3EVa4uTia6K/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Lando Calrissian _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,812 bytes, SHA-256 <code>dc72eef21b42d5c857c2c289cfa36c05622b2cf72826b496d4a0bad723c323d4</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

This is a fan print, not a Decipher or Players Committee card. It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set, not a PC or Decipher publication)” and is not shown on [[Lando Calrissian (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (Bill, 22 November 2026).

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.. It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
